# Changed-policy control

These three responses are handwritten controlled inputs, not real-model results.
They exercise the same high-level compiler, lexical children, saved-source
restoration, session-extension producers, TTMS closures, and Lain stage policy as
the live experiment. The control validates the machinery before making provider
calls. The model never receives the controlled execution source in its context.

The historical policy adds delivery after surcharge. The new policy surcharges
delivery as well. Both results share a retained event-only computation; separate
policy/question premise closures govern their availability. The control's expected
numbers and support sets live in the host evaluator, not in the provider context.
